SY417
Dimensions of Social Inequality in Canada
0.5 Credit
An advanced analysis of economic, social, and political inequality in Canada with emphasis on the contemporary realities of, and interconnections between, class, race, and gender relations. The analysis is situated within the context of international state relations and globalization.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY210
(or SY204*) or
SY213
or permission of the department.
Exclusions
SY452q.
